title: IRC: accepting with JOIN &invite-N leaves irssi typing into a dead channel
description: Found driving irssi 1.4.3 across two providers (2026-11-21). The pending invite is shown as INVITE alice-a &invite-1; JOIN &invite-1 accepts, but the server answers with JOIN #bside (the room's channel). irssi keeps a pending &invite-1 window as the active one, so the next line the user types goes to PRIVMSG &invite-1 and gets 403 No such channel. Options: (a) name the invite after the room's channel (INVITE alice-a #bside, JOIN #bside accepts), reading the name from the staged Welcome before joining, with &invite-N only as fallback; (b) keep &invite-N but answer the accept with JOIN &invite-1 then PART &invite-1 before JOIN #bside so clients close the placeholder. Needs Mark's choice.
